note: Kleiner Perkins' Drop is Massdrop, the San Francisco community commerce company (KPCB a previous backer at the 2014 Series A; bought by Corsair in 2023). Speedinvest's Drop is a 2022 B2B marketing tool for brands; its own note says it is not Massdrop.

Kleiner Perkins backed Syntellia, Inc., the San Francisco maker of the Fleksy keyboard (team hired by Pinterest in 2016, the product sold on in 2017). Speedinvest's row is ThingThing Ltd, the Barcelona company it backed in 2016 that later ran the Fleksy product and entered liquidation in 2025: a different legal company.
